rows.note: For numerical subtraction, this is the all-purpose choice, as in 七減二.

example.jyutping: cat1 gaam2 ji6 dang2 jyu1 ng5

rows.note: Use this when something is absent or not possessed; an action may add a verb such as 帶 or 著.

example.english: I went out minus an umbrella and got soaked.
example.traditional: 我冇帶遮出街，搞到成身濕晒。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mou5 daai3 ze1 ceot1 gaai1 gaau2 dou3 seng4 san1 sap1 saai3
